wnba.Headline: Sonia Citron, Shakira Austin lead closing charge for Mystics in 80-70 win over Sparks
wnba.Description: — Sonia Citron scored 21 points, Shakira Austin had 17 points and 11 rebounds, and the Washington Mystics rallied in the fourth quarter to defeat the Los Angeles Sparks 80-70 on Saturday night.

wnba.Headline: WNBA icons link discourse, scrutiny of league to growth, success
wnba.Description: Some of the WNBA's greatest players believe the increased discourse and scrutiny of the league is the result of the growth and success of the women's game.

wnba.Headline: The secrets behind Angel Reese's legendary rebounding
wnba.Description: Angel Reese isn't the tallest player in the league, and she isn't its best leaper. So how is it that she's grabbing rebounds at a pace never before seen in the WNBA?

wnba.Headline: Holly Winterburn scores season-high 20 and the Fire build early lead before holding off Storm 84-82
wnba.Description: — Holly Winterburn scored 18 of her career-high 20 points in the first half, Bridget Carleton had 14 points and nine rebounds, and the Portland Fire beat the Seattle Storm 84-82 on Friday night to secure a four-game season sweep.
